# Muzéo

> > Muzéo is an online art marketplace offering museum-quality prints and reproductions with integrated e-commerce and payment processing.

The platform features works from various artists including Iryna Kuznetsova (Iridi) and utilizes PayPal for secure payment transactions. Muzéo connects art enthusiasts with high-quality reproductions and original artworks through a streamlined digital commerce experience.

## Key Topics

- Muzéo
- Art marketplace
- Museum-quality prints
- PayPal integration
- Payment processing
- E-commerce platform
- Iryna Kuznetsova (Iridi)
- Payment gateway
- IPN (Instant Payment Notification)
- Art reproductions
- Online gallery
- Secure transactions

## Payment Integration

- [PayPal IPN Endpoint](https://en.muzeo.com/commerce_paypal/ipn/paypal_ec|commerce_payment_paypal_ec): PayPal Instant Payment Notification endpoint for processing payment callbacks and transaction verification
